audit_reference_contract.excluded: No chosen action, narrowed tier, opportunity score, RNG state hash, or game outcome
audit_reference_contract.purpose: Before candidate interpretation, independently regenerate the unchanged canonical legal list and V4 maximal tier/score and match the source B, ordered primary tier, tier digest and score exactly

observation_contract.board: public visible cells and public placement history only
observation_contract.canonical_encoding: sorted-key compact ensure_ascii JSON, finite numbers only, UTF-8, exactly one trailing newline
observation_contract.collected_equipment: public collected card, one-based action turn, player index
observation_contract.excluded_payloads: No audit tier/scores/chosen move/RNG hash, game result, draw pile, other player's hand, or private set-aside identities
observation_contract.exit_seen: acting player's knowledge in the canonical solo setup
observation_contract.format: Each snapshot JSON and each corpus JSONL row is exactly one serialized PlayerObservation, without an envelope
observation_contract.hand: acting player's own visible card definitions only
observation_contract.set_aside_unplayable: public count only; no private identities

selection.B_definition: candidate audit legal_move_count; no scorer or legal enumeration is invoked
selection.exclusion: B == 0 only; no outcome, chosen action, score, gain/loss, or terminal-result filter
selection.hash_group: lowest 64 SHA256 keys; ties by ascending seed then ordinal
selection.label: endstate-two-action-diagnostic-v1
selection.output_order: hash64 ascending SHA256,seed,ordinal; then stress16 descending cost,ascending seed,ordinal
selection.stress_cost_proxy: B * (B + 1) * C; arithmetic only, not measured successor branching
selection.stress_group: highest 16 cost proxies among remaining states; ties by ascending seed then ordinal
